events.title: CVS opens CUA Agent Kit as OpenAI expands healthcare computer use
events.title_zh: CVS 开源 CUA Agent Kit，OpenAI 扩大医疗 computer use
events.summary: OpenAI made computer use available in its API and healthcare products. CVS Health also released CUA Agent Kit under Apache 2.0: an agent records a workflow, then Codex compiles it into deterministic Playwright or pywinauto automation that can run without an LLM. CVS says the pattern cleared one backlog and now executes tens of thousands of consult steps per day.

events.why_it_matters: For teams automating repetitive browser or desktop work, the kit offers a testable path from flexible discovery to deterministic execution. Healthcare safety and deployment numbers are vendor-reported; traces and screenshots may contain credentials or protected data.

events.title: Tencent releases downloadable HY4 Flash weights after the API launch
events.title_zh: 腾讯在 API 上线后开放 HY4 Flash 权重下载
events.summary: Tencent released downloadable HY4 Flash instruction and base weights after launching the hosted API. The 220B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model activates about 12B parameters per token, supports a 1M-token context and includes vLLM, SGLang, quantization and fine-tuning instructions. It uses the custom Tencent Hy License.
events.summary_zh: 腾讯在托管 API 上线后开放 HY4 Flash 指令版与基础版权重下载。该多模态 MoE 总参数约 220B，每个 token 激活约 12B，支持 100 万 token 上下文，并提供 vLLM、SGLang、量化与微调指南。许可为自定义 Tencent Hy License。
events.why_it_matters: The event moves from hosted-only access to self-hosting and fine-tuning, materially changing the deployment choice. Hardware needs are substantial, the license is not Apache or MIT, and performance remains vendor-reported.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这次更新把模型从仅托管调用推进到可自托管和微调，实质改变部署选择。硬件需求很高，许可不是 Apache 或 MIT，性能仍是厂商自报。

events.title: OpenAI adds a restricted API classifier for potential CSAM
events.title_zh: OpenAI 新增受限的潜在 CSAM API 分类器
events.summary: OpenAI added omni-moderation-csam-latest to the Moderations API for approved organizations at no charge. It accepts one still image up to 20 MB and flags potential CSAM and potential AI-generated CSAM. It is not available for inline moderation or Batch API use.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Moderations API 中新增 omni-moderation-csam-latest，免费提供给获批组织。它一次接收一张不超过 20 MB 的静态图片，并标记潜在 CSAM 与潜在 AI 生成 CSAM。该模型不支持 inline moderation 或 Batch API。
events.why_it_matters: For approved trust-and-safety teams, this creates a dedicated screening control inside an existing API. OpenAI publishes no performance benchmark, and the scores are neither calibrated probabilities nor legal determinations.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对获批的 trust-and-safety 团队来说，这在现有 API 内增加了一项专用筛查控制。OpenAI 没有公开性能 benchmark；分数既不是校准后的概率，也不是法律认定。

events.title: Microsoft and UC Berkeley open TokenEconomizer for repeat coding work
events.title_zh: Microsoft 与 UC Berkeley 开源 TokenEconomizer
events.summary_en: Microsoft and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an MIT-licensed plugin that learns reusable micro-skills from earlier coding-agent sessions, prunes tools and interrupts failure loops. On 277 real bug-fixing tasks, the publishers report 18.4–30.9% lower cost with broadly stable success. The documented compatibility ranges trail the current monitored Claude Code and Codex releases.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft 与 UC Berkeley 发布 MIT 许可的 TokenEconomizer。它从过去的 coding agent 会话提炼可复用的微技能，精简工具，并在失败循环中介入。发布方在 277 个真实修 bug 任务上报告成本下降 18.4%–30.9%，成功率大体不变；文档所列兼容版本落后于当前 Claude Code 与 Codex 稳定版。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams running repeated repository work can test whether local learning reduces token spend without changing the underlying agent. The evidence is publisher-run and version compatibility may be the first practical blocker.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对反复处理同一代码库的团队来说，它可能在不更换 agent 的前提下降低 token 成本。现有证据来自发布方，版本兼容性可能是首先遇到的实际障碍。

events.title: SciResearch-Eval shows agents stay confident when simulators are wrong
events.title_zh: SciResearch-Eval 显示 agent 会对错误模拟器过度自信
events.summary_en: SciResearch-Eval tests whether research agents notice when a simulator omits important physics. Its held-out set contains 38 missing-physics tasks with objective interval scoring. Most tested agents placed the true answer inside their claimed 95% interval only 20–62% of the time, while two models scored much higher in the authors’ default runs.
events.summary_zh: SciResearch-Eval 测试科研 agent 能否发现模拟器漏掉了重要物理过程。held-out 集包含 38 个缺失物理机制的任务，并用客观区间评分。多数受测 agent 声称的 95% 区间只有 20%–62% 的情况包含真值；作者的默认运行中另有两个模型明显更高。
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams building scientific agents need to evaluate calibration under broken tools, not only answer accuracy with trusted simulators. The benchmark has public code, but the small test set and author-run results still need independent reproduction.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建科研 agent 的团队来说，只在可信模拟器上测答案对不对还不够，还要测工具出错时的不确定性是否诚实。benchmark 有公开代码，但测试集较小，结果仍需独立复现。

events.title: Hugging Face moves language-model routing to OpenRouter
events.title_zh: Hugging Face 将语言模型路由切换到 OpenRouter
events.summary_en: Hugging Face switched language-model traffic in Inference Providers to OpenRouter while keeping the Hugging Face token and API surface. The integration routes across more than 80 providers and adds automatic failover. Custom provider keys no longer work for language models, creating a migration break for some users.
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face 把 Inference Providers 的语言模型流量切换到 OpenRouter，同时保留 Hugging Face token 与 API 入口。新集成可在 80 多家 provider 间路由并自动故障转移。语言模型不再支持自带 provider key，这会让部分用户的现有配置失效。
events.why_it_matters_en: This changes the routing, billing and data path behind a widely used model gateway. Teams should verify provider controls, privacy terms and failure behavior rather than assuming the unchanged API means an unchanged service boundary.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这改变了常用模型网关背后的路由、计费与数据路径。团队不能因为 API 没变就假定服务边界没变，应重新核对 provider 控制、隐私条款与故障行为。

events.title: Hugging Face publishes harness adapters across three coding agents
events.title_zh: Hugging Face 发布适配三种编程 agent 的 harness adapter
events.summary: Hugging Face published Qwen3.8-27B adapters for pi, Hermes and OpenCode plus a merged super-adapter, with Apache-2.0 artifacts, trajectories and training data. Publisher runs show large gains inside each training harness and a smaller mean gain for the merged adapter. A 300-task held-out AutomationBench showed little out-of-domain improvement.
events.summary_en: Hugging Face published Qwen3.8-27B adapters for pi, Hermes and OpenCode plus a merged super-adapter, with Apache-2.0 artifacts, trajectories and training data. Publisher runs show large gains inside each training harness and a smaller mean gain for the merged adapter. A 300-task held-out AutomationBench showed little out-of-domain improvement.
events.summary_zh: Hugging Face 发布了面向 pi、Hermes 和 OpenCode 的 Qwen3.8-27B adapter，以及合并后的 super-adapter，并开放 Apache-2.0 产物、轨迹和训练数据。发布方测试显示，各专用 adapter 在对应 harness 内提升明显，合并版平均提升较小；300 题 held-out AutomationBench 几乎没有域外收益。
events.why_it_matters: The release makes harness-specific adaptation reproducible and shows that agent interfaces are part of model behavior. Results should not be compared across harnesses, Terminal-Bench influenced merge selection, and out-of-domain transfer remains weak.
events.why_it_matters_en: The release makes harness-specific adaptation reproducible and shows that agent interfaces are part of model behavior. Results should not be compared across harnesses, Terminal-Bench influenced merge selection, and out-of-domain transfer remains weak.

events.title: Study shows a 27B model can edit its own weights without gradients
events.title_zh: 研究显示 27B 模型可无梯度修改自身权重
events.summary: A preprint reports that a 27B open model inspected and directly edited its own weights without gradient training. On a fixed 490-problem test, one edit improved accuracy by 6.6 points, and a separate repair experiment restored performance across six unseen image benchmarks. Smaller 2B, 4B and 9B models did not reliably succeed.
events.summary_en: A preprint reports that a 27B open model inspected and directly edited its own weights without gradient training. On a fixed 490-problem test, one edit improved accuracy by 6.6 points, and a separate repair experiment restored performance across six unseen image benchmarks. Smaller 2B, 4B and 9B models did not reliably succeed.
events.summary_zh: 一篇预印本报告称，一个 27B 开放模型可以检查并直接修改自身权重，不使用梯度训练。一次修改在固定的 490 题测试上提升 6.6 个百分点；另一项修复实验还恢复了六个未见图像 benchmark 的表现。2B、4B 和 9B 模型未能稳定成功。
events.why_it_matters: Direct weight editing could eventually make persistent adaptation cheaper than retraining, but this is an early preprint with narrow tasks and no established production method. The claimed gain should not be generalized to arbitrary self-improvement.
events.why_it_matters_en: Direct weight editing could eventually make persistent adaptation cheaper than retraining, but this is an early preprint with narrow tasks and no established production method. The claimed gain should not be generalized to arbitrary self-improvement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 直接修改权重将来可能比重新训练更便宜地实现持久适配，但这仍是任务狭窄的早期预印本，没有成熟生产方法。不能把结果泛化为任意“自我进化”。

technical_details.method: Model reads activations and writes selected weight values directly; no gradients or training loop
technical_details.evaluation: Fixed 490-problem held-out test; reported +6.6 percentage points
technical_details.repair: Damaged-copy repair rose from 7% to 70% across six unseen image benchmarks, 83% of the undamaged model
technical_details.scale_boundary: 2B made no edit; 4B and 9B degraded; 27B succeeded in the reported setup
technical_details.evidence_limit: Preprint; narrow setups; no peer review or independent reproduction found in this run
technical_details.time_basis: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-11-16T20:55:08Z; recovered by recall audit outside overlap

technical_details_zh.方法: 模型读取 activation 并直接写入选定权重值；不使用梯度或训练循环
technical_details_zh.评测: 固定 490 题 held-out 测试；报告提升 6.6 个百分点
technical_details_zh.修复实验: 受损副本在六个未见图像 benchmark 上从 7% 升至 70%，达到未损坏模型的 83%
technical_details_zh.规模边界: 2B 没有修改；4B 与 9B 变差；27B 在报告设置中成功
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 预印本；场景狭窄；本轮未找到同行评审或独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间依据: arXiv v1 提交于 2026-11-16T20:55:08Z；本轮由召回审计在 overlap 外补录
